India to purchase five additional S-400 air-defence squadrons from Russia

India is moving ahead with a plan to acquire five additional S-400 air-defence squadrons from Russia. The decision follows the reported success of the S-400 system during Operation Sindoor. Russia has sent New Delhi a bill of quantities (BOQ) outlining the cost of the new batch. The purchase is presented as an expansion of the existing S-400 contract between the two countries. No specific cost figures or delivery timeline were disclosed in the reports.
